name: Megiddo Flame
doc: Megiddo Flame (Mobile Type 8's attack; 166's module at other addresses): the director and its tasks - a glow, spins and rings at the caster's effect point, bolts round the targets (arcs, gouraud sheets, ribbons), the stage captured from above for the column at the centre, the pillar, flames, sparks and debris, the party knocked down and thrown, the screen flashes and fades, the sounds; the action results. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx fx_megiddo.h, shared by 166 and 312) run on the program's memory (its pools, bolt records and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The timeline: the effect point at the caster's bone and the frame toward the targets' centre (every tick), when each part starts, the stage captured from above for the column, the screen flashes and fades, the sounds

parts.title: Glow
parts.doc: A glow model at the effect point, shrinking, fading at its end

parts.title: Spins
parts.doc: Two models at the effect point spinning (slowing down), fading in and out

parts.title: Rings
parts.doc: Ring models at the effect point every 6th tick, growing and fading

parts.title: Bolts
parts.doc: Bolts round the targets' centre (random splines): each an arc model from the effect point along it, a gouraud sheet between them and a widened ribbon on it

parts.title: Column
parts.doc: The column at the centre (textured with the stage drawn from above) and its flash, stretched up

parts.title: Pillar
parts.doc: The pillar model at the centre, growing up, fading

parts.title: Flames
parts.doc: Flame models round the centre (two kinds, scrolled), each after a delay, spinning, fading

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Spark sprites thrown round the centre (two a tick)

parts.title: Debris
parts.doc: Debris models thrown round the centre (three a tick), falling and turning

parts.title: Knock-down and landing
parts.doc: Each present party member knocked down, then thrown up, turned and landing (a ring model where it lands); the action result at the end

params.label: Start
params.doc: At the director's glow tick

params.label: Blast
params.doc: At the director's blast tick

params.label: Glow tick
params.doc: The glow (and the start sound) at this tick of the director

params.label: Bolts tick
params.doc: The two spins and the bolts start at this tick

params.label: Rings from
params.doc: Rings start on the ticks from this one to the next (each tick whose remainder by 6 is 2)

params.label: Rings until
params.doc: (the last tick a ring may start)

params.label: Column tick
params.doc: The column, its flash and the knock-downs start at this tick (the stage is captured the tick before)

params.label: Blast tick
params.doc: The blast sound at this tick

params.label: Pillar tick
params.doc: The pillar, the flames and the throws start at this tick

params.label: Sparks tick
params.doc: The sparks and the debris start at this tick

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The director's last tick (the white flash fades out from 0x5A to 0x62; the effect ends once every part has)

params.label: Effect point bone
params.doc: The caster's bone the effect point is on (0xF0 and up: the model's named points; below: a bone)

params.label: Effect point offset
params.doc: The effect point's offset in that bone's frame (x, y, z, pad) (8 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Size
params.doc: Its scale at the start (4096 = the model's own)

params.label: Shrink
params.doc: Taken from its scale on its first tick, 5/6 of that the next, and so on for 8 ticks

params.label: Glow model
params.doc: The prim model glow (a mesh of 73 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Size
params.doc: Their scale (4096 = the model's own)

params.label: Spin
params.doc: The first one's turn a tick: this + a random below the next (4096 = a full turn; 7/8 of it the next tick...; the second turns the other way by its first angle)

params.label: Spin random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Spin model
params.doc: The prim model spin (a mesh of 9 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Size
params.doc: Its scale at the start and its first growth (5/6 of it the next tick, and so on)

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 72 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices; the landing rings draw it too)

params.label: Count
params.doc: How many bolts (6 records: 6 at most)

params.label: Spread
params.doc: Each bolt's two ends: the centre moved by a random below this on x and z, centred

params.label: Arc model
params.doc: The prim model arc (a mesh of 65 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Sheet colours
params.doc: The sheet's colour words by its tick (12, in turn: red, green, blue, the GPU code byte) (48 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Column model
params.doc: The prim model column (a mesh of 176 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices; its own renderer textures it with the captured stage)

params.label: Column flash model
params.doc: The prim model column flash (a mesh of 110 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Pillar model
params.doc: The prim model pillar (a mesh of 192 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Count
params.doc: How many flames (each delayed by its number + a random below 4; the task pool holds 100 tasks: 64 at most)

params.label: Spread x
params.doc: A flame's place: the centre moved by a random below this on x, centred

params.label: Spread z
params.doc: ... and below this on z

params.label: Flame model a
params.doc: The prim model flame a (a mesh of 16 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices; drawn by the shared scrolling renderer)

params.label: Flame model b
params.doc: The prim model flame b (a mesh of 16 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Debris model 0
params.doc: The prim model debris 0 (a mesh of 12 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices; a debris piece is one of the three at random)

params.label: Debris model 1
params.doc: The prim model debris 1 (a mesh of 12 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

params.label: Debris model 2
params.doc: The prim model debris 2 (a mesh of 12 vertices: an edited one keeps its vertices)

not_editable.label: Reference direction
not_editable.doc: The direction (0, 0, -4096) its frames and arcs turn from (a math constant)

not_editable.label: Debris mesh pointers
not_editable.doc: The three debris mesh pointers (the meshes themselves are parameters: Debris)

not_editable.label: Alternate viewport
not_editable.doc: The draw environment put back after the stage capture
